hero.title: MBA in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: An **MBA in Mauritius for Indian Students** is a postgraduate business qualification for graduates and professionals who wish to improve their leadership, strategic thinking, financial management and decision making skills. Students can opt for general MBA programs or specializations in marketing, finance, human resources, international business and business analytics. Choosing to **Study MBA in Mauritius** gives students an opportunity to explore business education in an international environment while developing management and leadership skills.

overview: Some of the institutions offering MBA in Mauritius are Middlesex University Mauritius, The Open University of Mauritius, University of Mauritius, and Amity Institute of Higher Education. The length of the program, tuition fees, the way the courses are delivered and entry requirements vary, so students should compare each before applying. Students exploring an **MBA in Mauritius for Indian Students** should also compare the course structure, recognition, specialization options and international student fees before selecting a university.

faq.question: Duration of MBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Length: Varies by university and mode of study. Middlesex University Mauritius delivers the course in one year full time or two years part time. The University of Mauritius describes its MBA as a two-year part-time program, and the Open University of Mauritius offers a flexible two-to-four year route.

faq.question: How much does an MBA cost in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Published examples start at US$3,000forAmity’sMBAandgoupto£10,300forMiddlesexUniversityMauritius’sinternationalMBA.TheOpenUniversityofMauritiusMBAGeneralispricedatUS$6,845 for international students from outside the SADC. These fees have different program structures and need to be compared carefully. Students should also consider living expenses when calculating the overall Cost of MBA in Mauritius.

faq.question: Can the Indian students apply for MBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian students can apply if they meet the academic, English language and other entry requirements of the chosen university. They should also verify the applicable international fee category and student-permit process before accepting an offer. An MBA in Mauritius for Indian Students can be considered by graduates who meet the programme-specific admission criteria.

faq.question: Is work experience a mandatory requirement for an MBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Not always. Requirements differ from university to university and program to program. Some MBA programs will look at graduates with little work experience, others will expect relevant professional or management experience. Please check the exact entry requirements when applying.

faq.question: Which is the best university for MBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The best choice will depend on your budget, preferred mode of study, specialization, entry qualifications and career aspirations. Middlesex University Mauritius has specialist MBA pathways while the University of Mauritius offers a number of part-time options, the Open University of Mauritius has a flexible distance-learning route and Amity lists full-time and online options. Before you decide, check out program recognition, curriculum, total cost and admission requirements. Students should compare the available MBA Programs in Mauritius and review the course structure, tuition fees and recognition before making a final decision.
